error.message: Producing an exact, verified mapping for all 1,687 concepts in a single response exceeds safe message size and reliability constraints (risk of truncation and mismapped IDs). To ensure correctness and preserve every mongodb_id with clear keep/merge/rename actions, please allow batching.
proposed_process: Step 1: Confirm the 12 root categories below (or adjust).
Step 2: Send the 1,687 concepts in 8-10 batches (e.g., 180-220 concepts per batch) or allow me to stream multiple replies.
Step 3: I will return for each batch: complete concept_mappings with explicit keep/merge/rename, new_parent_slug, and merge_into_id, plus a per-batch verification.
Step 4: I will provide a final consolidated verification with output_count=1687 and empty unmapped_ids.
batching_options: Option A: You provide batches of mongodb_id lists; I map them.
Option B: I propose deterministic batches (e.g., by first letter of slug or by entity_type) and proceed in sequence.
notes: Merges will preserve all mongodb_id values; only target concept will receive merges.
All synonyms/aliases that represent the same semantic concept (e.g., 'LLM', 'LLMs', 'large_language_model') will be merged to a single canonical concept.
Auto-generated 'topic' duplicates will be resolved into canonical research entities or products where appropriate.

root_categories.description: Foundational concepts, fields, and theory in AI/ML (e.g., ML, DL, NLP, CV, scaling laws).
Model families (e.g., GPT, Llama, Claude, Gemini) and core architectures (Transformer, SSM, CNN, RNN, Diffusion).
Training/inference techniques, optimization, prompting, RAG, quantization, distillation, decoding strategies.
Pre-training, fine-tuning, instruction-tuning, post-training (RLHF/DPO/GRPO), PEFT methods like LoRA.
Datasets, data sources, data curation/filtering, licenses, and data standards.
Benchmarks, metrics, evaluation practices, leaderboards, and model comparison methodology.
Downstream tasks (QA, NER, MT, ASR, OCR, code gen) and product/application use-cases.
Modalities (text, image, audio, video) and multimodal models (VLMs) and pipelines.
Safety, ethics, interpretability, privacy, red-teaming, environmental impact, governance.
Organizations, events, releases, market dynamics, industry news.
Software/frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, Transformers), formats (GGUF), and standards (OWL, SPARQL, RDFS).
People, organizations, locations, products, research entities (models, methods, benchmarks, metrics, tasks).
